summary: Gyrodyne, LLC filed an 8-K on October 19, 2026 disclosing that its wholly-owned subsidiary GSD Cortlandt, LLC, with Gyrodyne as limited guarantor, entered a letter agreement with lender SIG CRE 2023 Venture LLC extending the maturity of a $4.95 million mortgage loan secured by 1985 Crompond Road, Cortlandt Manor, New York, by five years to October 10, 2031. The rate reset to 7.28% per annum and a $431,411.38 principal paydown was made, leaving an outstanding balance of $4,041,482.21. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
